description.narrative: Engro Corporation Limited (Engro or the Company) has entered into an Amalgamation Agreement with Pakistan Mobile Communications Limited (PMCL), for a total arrangement of US$ 562.7mn, under which 100% shareholding of PMCLs wholly owned subsidiary, Deodar Private Limited (Deodar), will vest under Engro Connect Private Limited (Transaction). IFC has been invited to provide a loan facility of up to US$ 30mn and mobilize additional debt financing to partly fund Engros acquisition of Deodar (the Project).

The expected development impact of this transaction stems from its potential to improve the capacity of mobile networks by facilitating infrastructure sharing, which could result in market-wide improved access to digital services. Specifically, the Project is expected to increase tower infrastructure sharing among Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) on an open access basis which will enable MNOs to accelerate deployment of high-speed mobile networks in a cost-effective manner, resulting in increased access to quality mobile connectivity for individuals and businesses. Beyond the project outcomes, the Project is also expected to deepen the competitiveness of the mobile connectivity market and potentially create a competitive market for tower colocation, through demonstration and replication at large scale of an innovative business model.
